releaseNotes:
• Android 16 Scoped Storage Consent: Full support for MediaStore.createDeleteRequest on Android 11–16, safely handling storage clearance for reinstalls and legacy downloads while keeping history records intact.
• Seamless Zero-Flicker Native Splash Screen: Integrated androidx.core:core-splashscreen directly into MainActivity, eliminating trampoline flickers and preserving full ClipData intents and Predictive Back physics.
• Hardened Self-Updater & APK Signature Verification: Enterprise-grade updater verifying device policy (DISALLOW_INSTALL_UNKNOWN_SOURCES), cryptographic APK signing certificates against running app, and cross-process ClipData grants for dual-installer OEMs.
• EMA Monotonic Transfer Rate & ETA Smoothing: Real-time download progress displaying exponentially smoothed network throughput and accurate time remaining.
